definitions.explanation: Participation in a crime together with another person. Can refer to the act of being complicit or to the person who is an accomplice.

examples.japanese: {共犯|きょうはん}{者|しゃ}が{逮捕|たいほ}された。
{二人|ふたり}は{共犯|きょうはん}{関係|かんけい}にあった。
{彼|かれ}は{事件|じけん}の{共犯|きょうはん}として{起訴|きそ}された。
examples.english: He was charged as an accomplice in the case.

notes:
Used in legal and criminal contexts. Can function as both the abstract concept (complicity) and to describe the person ({共犯|きょうはん}{者|しゃ}).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {共犯|きょうはん}{者|しゃ} (accomplice)
- {共犯|きょうはん}{関係|かんけい} (relationship as accomplices)
- {共犯|きょうはん}として (as an accomplice)

LEGAL USAGE:
In Japanese criminal law, {共犯|きょうはん} is a technical term covering various forms of joint criminal liability, including {共同|きょうどう}{正犯|せいはん} (co-principal), {教唆犯|きょうさはん} (instigator), and {幇助犯|ほうじょはん} (aiding and abetting).
